limitations: P1 is an architecture control, not a product experience; it may not be read as how a user runs Claude Code.
Every task is read-only and short-answer, so this benchmark does not measure code-writing outcomes.
Provider cost figures are vendor client-side estimates, not billing records.
The native profile's cost depends on how many files its agent loop chooses to read, which varies between runs.
Cache-off samples for the AER profile use the production request builder and parser with a harness-owned spawn, because the transport deliberately does not inherit vendor cache-policy environment.

samples.output: Before making real calls, a delegated provider's authentication status must be confirmed via the smallest allowed real model call as the authoritative connectivity check (since reported auth status is only advisory), and if that connectivity check cannot establish this, the runtime must fail closed (or move to a transport/profile that can) rather than proceeding.

A delegated provider's authentication state must be established as an attributable, isolated AER-request-envelope session distinct from any inherited provider-local behavior, and if that separation cannot be established the runtime must fail closed rather than make the call.

A supported delegated authentication session must be established before real provider calls are made, and if that cannot be established, the runtime must fail closed rather than substitute or silently proceed.
A verified provider-attributable delegated authentication session must be established, and if it cannot be, the runtime must fail closed rather than make the call.

A real provider call is acceptable only when authentication is attributable to the AER request envelope and AER policy rather than silently inherited provider-local/user-level session state, and if that separation cannot be established the runtime must fail closed or move to a transport/profile that can establish it.

The delegated session's authentication status must be treated as advisory and verified by actually issuing the smallest allowed real model call as the authoritative connectivity check, and if that cannot succeed the runtime must fail closed rather than proceed with the call.
